title: HEALTH AND PHYSICAL FITNESS
modules: Promoting Active Lifestyles And Sustainable Fitness
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major cause of chronic diseases."
Lack of exercise is a major cause of chronic diseases.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a broad term that includes all forms of bodily movement encountered in daily life, such as walking for transportation, occupational tasks, household chores, and recreational pursuits."

Physical activity is a broad term that includes all forms of bodily movement encountered in daily life, such as walking for transportation, occupational tasks, household chores, and recreational pursuits.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the best measure of physical fitness."
Body weight alone is the best measure of physical fitness.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to attributes that are directly associated with health status and disease prevention."
Health-related fitness refers to attributes that are directly associated with health status and disease prevention.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a 32-year-old ODL university student living in Lagos."
Toyin is a 32-year-old ODL university student living in Lagos.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means is the first step towards making informed decisions that support your overall well-being."
Understanding what health really means is the first step towards making informed decisions that support your overall well-being.
fib: ______ refers to the maximum force a muscle or muscle group can exert and is commonly assessed using one-repetition maximum (1RM) tests, handgrip dynamometry, or isometric strength measures (McArdle et al., 2023).

Muscular strength refers to the maximum force a muscle or muscle group can exert and is commonly assessed using one-repetition maximum (1RM) tests, handgrip dynamometry, or isometric strength measures (McArdle et al., 2023).
______ is a direct investment in your overall quality of life.
Excellent physical fitness is a direct investment in your overall quality of life.
______ is a primary school teacher in Enugu studying for his degree online.
Emeka is a primary school teacher in Enugu studying for his degree online.
______ is a critical component of effective health, physical education, and exercise programmes.
Physical fitness assessment is a critical component of effective health, physical education, and exercise programmes.
______ is a planned, structured, and purposeful form of physical activity designed to improve or maintain fitness.
Exercise is a planned, structured, and purposeful form of physical activity designed to improve or maintain fitness.
______ refers to the relative proportions of fat mass and fat- free mass in the body, including muscle, bone, organs, and body fluids.
Body composition refers to the relative proportions of fat mass and fat- free mass in the body, including muscle, bone, organs, and body fluids.
